info.name: Public Account Pairing Endpoints Auth Endpoints API

items.docs: Client credentials in the request-body and HTTP Basic Auth are supported.

params.name: client_id
params.description: The ID of the client (also known as the Application ID).

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: The URI to where the user should be redirected when the flow is successfully completed. It must be previously registered at Developer Portal in the application settings.

params.name: response_type
params.description: Specifies the expected response type. Only "code" is accepted.

params.name: scope
params.description: The scope to request, multiple scopes are passed delimited by a space character.

params.name: state
params.description: Can be used to store request-specific data. The server will return the unmodified state value back to the application.

params.name: code_challenge
params.description: A code verifier generated by the client application transformed by applying a cryptographic hash function, such as SHA-256, and encoding the result using URL-safe Base64 encoding.

params.name: code_challenge_method
params.description: Method used to transform the code verifier. The most common method is "S256", which stands for SHA-256.

items.docs: Request a user's authorization to perform action on their behalf
